answer: Imagine two gardeners growing a crystal in a quiet room: each crystal gains one layer per epoch, and weight equals layers squared, so a crystal grown for 10 epochs weighs 100. A gale cannot hurry growth, layers form in order, never in parallel, and no layer transfers to a fresh crystal. Split care across 10 new crystals and each weighs 1, 10 in total against 100. One honest gardener tends a single ivory crystal and lets its seasons compound.
